title: A second inspector replaces the first
goal: Another inspector is to be tried on {{castKey}}, at {{castOwner}}'s request, while {{castApp}} is {{castTask}}.
obstacle: A key has one external inspector. Adding another must not leave two half-configured.
control: Selecting the second inspector replaces the first and says which one went. The same prompt now comes back with the second inspector's own category names.
